messages:
olivia: Heads-up: planned spot-eviction resilience test in ap-southeast-1 next Thursday 23:30-00:30 local. Goal: validate autoscale + fallback routing.

sam: Scope? which pools will be targeted?

olivia: Targeting preemptible node pools only (label node.k8s.io/lifecycle=spot). Excluding dedicated/reserved pools. Affected services: inference runtime, local kvcache on those nodes, edge-router pods colocated.

ops-bot: test_scheduled: spot-evict-ap1-1919991111. Canary start 23:15. Docs: https://internal/ops/tests/1919991111

kevin: Canary plan: run synthetic mix at 23:15 at 5% traffic. Abort if error rate >0.7% for 10m or p99 >350ms for 5m.

mira: We'll pre-warm cache replicas beforehand: `rd-cache-warm --region ap1 --keyset core_prompts --replicas 2`. Post-drain warm also recommended.

sam: I'll add a temporary traffic-router policy to divert affected traffic to `fallback-quant` if alarms trigger.

olivia: Oncall is @kevin from 23:00-01:00. Please post to #incidents if aborting. Test results and metrics collection link will be posted to the ops page after run. :white_check_mark:
